lines.ja: よく皆さん、
lines.en: You know how everyone,
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: 海外の人とかがよくやってる、
lines.en: foreigners and people often do,
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: なんか耐久系の動画があるの知りません？
lines.en: don't you know those endurance challenge videos?
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: 例えばピンポン玉を鍋にポンポンポンって入れるやつとか。
lines.en: Like bouncing ping-pong balls into a pot.
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: あ〜、かっこいい動画みたいなやつね。
lines.en: Ah, like those cool trick shot videos, right?
lines.speaker: Shunta

lines.ja: そうそう。きゅうりをトランプで一刀両断！
lines.en: Exactly. Like slicing a cucumber clean through with a playing card!
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: みたいなやつって結構あったんですよ。
lines.en: There were quite a few videos like that.
lines.speaker: Jinto

clips.title: Accidental Success Derails the Plan
grammar: 〜たらいい — it would be fine if

lines.ja: 成功〜！
lines.en: Success!
lines.speaker: Hayato

lines.ja: よっしゃあ！
lines.en: All right!
lines.speaker: Hayato

lines.ja: もう四人刺さるまでやろう。
lines.en: Let's keep going until all four of us stick one.
lines.speaker: Shunta

lines.ja: 全員できるまでやろう、それは。
lines.en: Yeah, let's keep going until everyone does it.
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: そ、そうしよう、本当に。
lines.en: L-let's do that, seriously.
lines.speaker: Hayato

lines.ja: そうだよ。
lines.en: Exactly.
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: いや、すごない？もう俺いいや。
lines.en: Wait, isn't that amazing? I'm good now.
lines.speaker: Shunta

lines.ja: やだよ、なんでだよ！
lines.en: No way, why not?!
lines.speaker: Hayato

lines.ja: 全員できたらいいじゃん、それは。
lines.en: Wouldn't it be better if everyone succeeded?
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: なんで？今休憩しようよ、お腹もあれだし。
lines.en: Why? Let's take a break now, our stomachs are full anyway.
lines.speaker: Shunta

lines.ja: いやいや、やろうよ！
lines.en: No, no, let's do it!
lines.speaker: Jyutaro

lines.ja: え？
lines.en: Huh?
lines.speaker: Shunta

lines.ja: 舜太はまぁ、気遣って言ってなかったよね、最初ね。
lines.en: Shunta was being polite and didn't say anything at first, right?
lines.speaker: Jyutaro

lines.ja: 最初なんか、ちょっと何？何で？って思ったけど、そういう日なのかなって。
lines.en: At first I wondered what was going on, but then I thought, maybe he's just having that kind of day.
lines.speaker: Shunta

lines.ja: どういう日だよ、それ！
lines.en: What kind of day is that?!
lines.speaker: Hayato

lines.ja: ねえだろ、俺そんな日！
lines.en: I'd never have a day like that!
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: で、どこで気付いたの？段階的には。
lines.en: So at which stage did you realize?
lines.speaker: Hayato

lines.ja: 最後でしょ？
lines.en: The end, right?
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: ちょんまげでしょ？
lines.en: With the topknot, right?
lines.speaker: Hayato

lines.ja: ちょんまげして、でも別にそれドッキリだとは思わなくて。
lines.en: He did the topknot, but even then I didn't think it was a prank.
lines.speaker: Shunta

lines.ja: なんか、よくあるやん、１回出て行って被って出てくるイェーイ！みたいな。
lines.en: Like, you know how people step out and come back wearing something goofy like, 'Yeah!'?
lines.speaker: Shunta

lines.ja: あ、ちょっとふざけみたいなね。
lines.en: Ah, just clowning around a bit.
lines.speaker: Jinto

lines.ja: モノボケしてんだ！って思ってた。
lines.en: I just thought, 'Oh, he's doing a prop gag!'
lines.speaker: Shunta
